refuter.evidence: cfplus0.cob (PAGE 15 HEADING 1 FD 4 LD 10 FOOTING 12; DE-A LINE PLUS 1 NEXT GROUP 9; CF-1 for WS-K1 with one line, LINE PLUS 0). Two GENERATEs put DA on 4 (LC 9) and 10 (LC 12, saved 9). A control break then presents CF-1. --std 85 printed PAGE 2 LINE 10 [CF10], then DA on PAGE 3 LINE 4. --std 2023 printed the same. The 1985 text gives a different page. CF-1 is a body group of row 'R / no NEXT GROUP', so fit test 3b applies. A body group has been presented on page 1, so the trial sum is LC 12 + integer 0 = 12, which is not greater than the control footing's lower limit (FOOTING 12), so 'the report group is presented on the current page'. Rule 4b, second paragraph (a body group already presented on the page): line = LC + integer of the first LINE NUMBER clause = 12. So CF-1 belongs on PAGE 1 LINE 12, with LC 12 and the saved 9 still pending for DE-A. The code's PresentBody/PlaceAfterSavedNextGroup always takes a page advance when _nextGroupSave != 0 and places a relative first line at saved+1 (the 2023 GR4a model: 'a page advance ... before any other non-dummy body group'). It has no edition arm, so at 85 the first relative line of a body group is not placed 'by specified rules (Presentation Rules Tables)' (GR4 second paragraph) when integer-2 is 0. The reader's own requirement says 'else LINE-COUNTER+integer-2' for a body group that is not first on the page, and the code breaks that. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.3.15.4 GR4 ("determined by specified rules"); OK §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR3b ("If the trial sum is not greater than the body group's lower limit integer, then the report group is presented on the current page"); OK §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR4b ("adding the content of LINE-COUNTER and the integer of the first LINE NUMBER clause of the current body group"); OK §1985:XIII.3.10.8 GR2 (CF lower limit = FOOTING); OK §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR1 ("Integer-2 may be zero"). Other probes matched: ngcf (CH/DE/CF relative first lines, PF NEXT GROUP PLUS 2 then RF PLUS 1 on 29 = 28+1, rule 3.10.10 3b).

refuter.corrected: NON-CONFORMING (wrong-answer), cause (a): at --std 85 this edition needs its own arm. After a body group's absolute NEXT GROUP fills the save location (LC = FOOTING), a control footing whose first line is LINE PLUS 0 passes fit test 3b (12 + 0 <= FOOTING 12) and must be presented on the current page at LC + 0 (rule 4b). The compiler instead advances the page and prints it at saved+1 (page 2, line 10), at 85 the same as at 2023. Repro: E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-146/src/cfplus0.cob. Expected per 1985: PAGE 1 LINE 12 [CF12]. Observed: PAGE 2 LINE 10 [CF10]. It is narrow (only a first relative line of integer 0 in a group whose lower limit is FOOTING), but the rule text decides it.

adjudication.reason: Report Writer. After a body group's absolute NEXT GROUP saves its integer, the next relative group whose LINE integers sum to zero (a control footing with LINE PLUS 0) is sent to the next page. The 1985 fit test keeps it on the page: a body group HAS been presented there, so the saved integer is not consulted. The forced page advance is the 2023 rule, applied at every edition. Narrow: only a relative group of integer sum 0 whose lower limit is at least the FOOTING line. The rules it rests on are printed text (folios XIII-32 to XIII-36), not reconstruction.
